title: capability re-announce POST is plaintext; spec 8.12 mandates OSCORE (root returns 4.01)
description: Security review of 99sg.2 (pass 2, finding 1): node.py _reannounce_capabilities_to_new_root builds a bare aiocoap Message and raw-encodes it via wrap_coap — no OSCORE option. spec/06-security.md:946-947 mandates OSCORE with the pairwise announcer-root context; root validation step 1 (:993) verifies OSCORE. The in-repo root CapabilityAnnounceResource.render_post returns 4.01 oscore_required for plaintext (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/capability_announce.py:184-189), so the 99sg.2 re-announce is dead-on-arrival against the project's own root. A passive radio adversary also learns node identity/IID/capabilities in cleartext (spec :1053 rationale). Fix requires node-side OSCORE client context establishment (EDHOC) toward the new root, or an explicit interim design decision by Mark.
